name: A Weaponsmith, Not a Warlord
summary: This model cannot be your Warlord; while attached to a unit led by an Inquisitor, its Objective Control characteristic is 1.

name: Abomination
summary: This model has the Feel No Pain 2+ ability against Psychic Attacks.

name: Acrobatic Escape
summary: At the end of the Fight phase, if engaged, this unit can Fall Back up to D6". If more than 3" from enemies at the end of your opponent's turn, it can enter strategic reserves and must ingress next Movement phase (incl. turn one).

name: Arbites Medi-kit
summary: At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer's unit is below its Starting Strength, up to D3 destroyed non-character models can be returned to it.

name: Authority of the Inquisition
summary: While attached to a unit, this model can embark within any Transport that its Bodyguard unit can embark within.

name: Backroom Deals
summary: During Battle Formations, select one friendly unit with this ability: while it leads a unit, models in that unit gain the Infiltrators ability.

name: Blessed Wardings
summary: While attached to a unit, models in that unit gain a 6+ invulnerable save.

name: Bound Daemon
summary: While attached to a unit led by an Inquisitor, this model's Objective Control characteristic is 1.

name: Breaching Team
summary: Attacks from this unit re-roll a Wound roll of 1, or any Wound roll if the target is within range of an objective marker.

name: CASSIUS
summary: This named model and its kill team version cannot both be included in the same army.

name: CAT Unit
summary: Once per battle, when this unit is selected to shoot, its ranged weapons gain the Ignores Cover ability until the end of the phase.

name: Catechism of Death
summary: While this unit contains Chaplain Cassius, its models' melee weapons gain the Devastating Wounds ability.

name: Deadshot
summary: While this unit is shooting, enemy units lose Lone Operative and hidden enemy units gain +15" detection range.

name: Dedication to Duty
summary: When a model in this unit that has not yet fought is destroyed in melee, roll a die: on a 4+ it still fights before being removed from play.

name: Dominate Will (Psychic)
summary: At the start of your opponent's Shooting phase, target a visible enemy Infantry unit within 12" and roll a die: a 1 deals this model D3 mortal wounds, a 2-5 gives that unit -1 to Hit, a 6 stops it shooting, until end of phase.

name: Endurant Shield
summary: The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save.

name: Etheric Emergence
summary: When arriving via Deep Strike in your Movement phase, this model can instead be set up more than 6" from all enemy units, but cannot declare a charge that turn.

name: Frenzon
summary: This model is eligible to shoot and to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

name: Gaze into the Empyrean (Psychic)
summary: Enemy Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" of this model.

name: Gheistskull
summary: Once per battle, when targeting this unit with the Explosives Stratagem, you can select an enemy unit within 18" (rather than 8") that is visible and not in Engagement Range of your units.

name: Glovodan Psyber-eagle
summary: In your Command phase, one enemy unit within 18" of the bearer loses the Benefit of Cover until the start of your next Command phase.

name: Grim Spectres
summary: After this unit shoots, one enemy unit it hit must take a Battle-shock test with -1 to the result.

name: Healing Serum
summary: At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer's unit is below its Starting Strength, up to D3 destroyed non-character models can be returned to it.

name: Holy Hatred
summary: While attached to a unit, melee weapons of models in that unit gain the Sustained Hits 1 ability.

name: Imperial Law
summary: At the start of the battle, nominate one enemy unit: attacks from this unit against it gain the Lethal Hits and Precision abilities.

name: Incensor Cherub
summary: Once per battle, this unit can be targeted with the Command Re-roll Stratagem for 0CP, even if that Stratagem has already been used on a different unit this phase.

name: Inconceivable Augmentation
summary: While attached to a unit, ranged weapons of models in that unit gain the Lethal Hits ability.

name: INQUISITORIAL AGENT
summary: If your army is not Agents of the Imperium, each unique pairing of an Inquisitorial Agents unit with this ability and a partner unit lets you include one more Character unit than normal.

name: INQUISITORIAL HENCHMEN
summary: If your army is not Agents of the Imperium, each Inquisitor unit lets you include an extra unit with this ability that does not count against your Retinue limit.

name: INQUISITORIAL RETINUE
summary: This unit can join an Inquisitor-led allied unit during Battle Formations, counting as part of it and increasing that unit's Starting Strength; outside Agents of the Imperium armies, pairing it also raises your Retinue unit limit by 1.

name: Jump Pack
summary: The bearer has a Move characteristic of 12" (10" on one datasheet) and can move over models and terrain features as if they were not there.

name: Kill Team
summary: When a mixed-Toughness unit with this ability is attacked, the attacker uses the majority Toughness value, and certain larger models count as taking up two Transport slots.

name: Lord of Deceit (Aura)
summary: Enemy Stratagems used to target a unit within 12" of this model cost 1 extra CP.

name: Loyal Henchmen
summary: While led by an Inquisitor, attacks that target this unit suffer -1 to the Wound roll.

name: Malefic Warding
summary: While attached to a unit led by an Inquisitor, models in that unit gain a 5+ invulnerable save.

name: Malefic Wardings (Psychic)
summary: While attached to a unit, models in that unit gain a 6+ invulnerable save, improved to 4+ against Psychic Attacks and attacks from Daemon models.

name: Malus Codicium
summary: While attached to a unit, this model doubles the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by Daemonhost models in that unit.

name: Masters of Close Confines
summary: Ranged attacks from this unit against the closest eligible target gain the Lethal Hits ability.

name: Merciless Judgement
summary: Ranged attacks from this unit against a target Below Half-strength gain +1 to the Wound roll.

name: NAVY BODYGUARD
summary: If your army is not Agents of the Imperium, each Voidfarers Character unit you include lets you add an extra unit with this ability that does not count against your Retinue limit.

name: No Mercy
summary: While attached to a unit, attacks made by models in that unit against a target Below Half-strength gain +1 to the Hit roll.

name: Nuncio Aquila
summary: Once per battle, at the start of any Command phase, target one objective marker within 6" of the bearer: enemy units within range of it, excluding Monsters and Vehicles, must take a Battle-shock test.

name: Nuncio Aquila (Aura)
summary: Once per battle, at the start of any Command phase, target one objective marker within 6" of the bearer: enemy units within range of it, excluding Monsters and Vehicles, must take a Battle-shock test.

name: On My Signal, Fire!
summary: After this unit shoots, friendly Agents of the Imperium or Imperium Infantry Battleline models can re-roll Hit rolls against one enemy unit it hit, until the end of the phase.

name: Overkill
summary: Once per battle, before this model makes a Normal move, it can gain +6" Move and +3 Attacks on its melee weapons until the end of the turn.

name: Power of the Rosette
summary: Each time this model's unit is targeted by a Stratagem, roll a die: on a 3+ you gain 1CP.

name: Proteus Doctrines
summary: Attacks from this unit against a target that is not Below Half-strength gain +1 to the Hit roll.

name: Psychic Assassin
summary: When this weapon targets a Psyker unit, its Attacks characteristic becomes 6 for those attacks.

name: Psychic Gifts
summary: The bearer has the Psyker keyword.

name: Psychic Veil (Psychic)
summary: In your Command phase, this Psyker can roll a die: on a 1 its unit suffers D3 mortal wounds, on a 2+ that unit can only be targeted by ranged attacks from within 18" until your next Command phase.

name: Psyoculum
summary: While attached to a unit, ranged weapons of models in that unit gain the Anti-Psyker 4+ ability.

name: Reign of Confusion
summary: Once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit within 12" of this model with a Stratagem, you can increase that Stratagem's CP cost by 1.

name: Rites of Teleportation
summary: If an Inquisitor unit is attached to this unit during Battle Formations, models in the merged unit gain the Deep Strike ability.

name: SHADOW ASSIGNMENT
summary: This model cannot be your Warlord; in an Agents of the Imperium army it can be swapped during Battle Formations for another Officio Assassinorum model of equal or lower points, with no duplicate Assassin types allowed.

name: Shieldbreaker
summary: Once per battle, this model's signature rifle can fire a special round: until the end of the phase, its attacks gain +1 to Wound and any successful Wound roll scores a Critical Wound.

name: Simulacrum Imperials
summary: Models in the bearer's unit have their Leadership improved by 1.

name: Soulguilt Scanner
summary: Ranged weapons of models in the bearer's unit gain the Ignores Cover ability.

name: Soulless Horror
summary: Once per battle, at the start of any Command phase, every enemy unit within 9" of this model must take a Battle-shock test with -1 to the result, or -2 if it is a Psyker.

name: Spy Network
summary: Each time your opponent gains a CP from an ability, roll a die: on a 2+ you also gain 1CP.

name: Third Eye (Psychic)
summary: At the start of your Shooting phase, target a visible enemy unit within 12": it must take a Battle-shock test, worsened by 2 if it is Infantry, and suffers 3 mortal wounds if the test is failed.

name: Throne of Judgement (Aura)
summary: Friendly units within 6" of this model have their Leadership improved by 1; enemy units within 6" have their Leadership worsened by 1.

name: Tome-skull
summary: Once per battle for each token this unit has, at the start of any phase, it can remove Battle-shocked status from a nearby friendly unit or force a nearby enemy unit to take a Battle-shock test.

name: Tox-cycler
summary: After this unit shoots, if this model's signature weapon scored a hit, it permanently gains +2 Strength and +2 Damage, to a maximum Damage of 6.

name: TRANSPORT
summary: This unit cannot embark within an Imperial Rhino.

name: Unflinching
summary: Battle-shock tests taken for this unit can be re-rolled.

name: Unsubtle Crusader
summary: During Battle Formations, select up to three friendly Agents of the Imperium Infantry units, or one Imperium Battleline unit, to gain the Scouts 6" ability.

name: Vox-cast Proclamations (Aura)
summary: Enemy Stratagems used to target a unit within 12" of this unit's named character cost 1 extra CP.

name: Vox-skull
summary: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, target a non-Monster, non-Vehicle enemy unit within 12": it must take a Battle-shock test, and loses the Benefit of Cover until the start of your next turn if it fails.

name: Ward Against the Malefic Arts
summary: While attached to a unit, Psychic Attacks that target that unit suffer -1 to the Hit roll and -1 to the Wound roll.

name: Warrant of Trade
summary: If your army includes a unit with this ability, after deployment, select up to D3 IMPERIUM BATTLELINE units and redeploy them, optionally into Strategic Reserves regardless of the normal limit.

name: Xenos Hunter
summary: While attached to a unit, attacks made by models in that unit against a target without the Imperium or Chaos keywords gain +1 to the Hit roll.

name: Assigned Agents
summary: If every model in your army has IMPERIUM (even without your Army Faction), you can include a battle-size-limited number of AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM retinue, character, and requisitioned units.

name: Kill Team
summary: When this unit (containing mixed-Toughness models) is attacked, wound rolls use the majority (or highest-tied) Toughness in the unit; larger models each count as 2 for transport capacity, and all models count as Infantry for terrain.
